functions.description: Rectangle corner collision against linked list
functions.notes: Struct offsets fixed (x@ac,w@a8,y@ae,h@aa), prologue load order and x spill slot now match to 0x44. Remaining: target keeps list cursor in sl and shares the zero in r4 between result and the nibble init; ours allocates cursor in r4/r8 (register allocation shift). colorsweep only offered volalias:self (volatile cast trick, rejected). ~16 gate runs.
